projects.title: Journaling Website
projects.description: A personal journal website where users can log their thoughts and reflections securely. This project utilizes Firebase authentication and Firestore for data storage.
projects.technologies:
Technologies Used:
Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
Backend & Auth: Google Firebase (Authentication & Firestore)

projects.title: The Aura Store
projects.description: A fully functional, customizable e-commerce platform designed for showcasing in a developer portfolio. Built with Firebase for backend and order management, integrated with Razorpay for secure payments, and uses EmailJS to automate order confirmation emails.
projects.technologies:
Technologies Used:
Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
UI Libraries: Swiper.js, GSAP, FontAwesome
Backend: Firebase Firestore
Payments: Razorpay API
Email: EmailJS API

projects.title: Agentic Travel Planner
projects.description: A production-ready autonomous travel agent and itinerary planner. Powered by multi-LLM orchestration and Model Context Protocol (MCP), it searches real flights and hotels via Amadeus, checks weather via Open-Meteo, generates automated car rental bookings, and handles checkout sessions.
projects.technologies:
Technologies Used:
Backend & Architecture: Python, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Model Context Protocol (MCP)
LLM Orchestration: Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4o
APIs & Services: Amadeus Self-Service API, Open-Meteo, Stripe Checkout
Frontend: HTML5, Modern CSS, JavaScript (Streaming NDJSON Chat UI)
DevOps & Deployment: Docker, Render CI/CD

projects.title: Naira - Virtual AI Assistant
projects.description: Naira is a web-based AI assistant that supports both voice and text interaction. Featuring a futuristic UI with a glowing core animation, it enables real-time, intelligent conversations using Mistral-7B-Instruct via OpenRouter.
projects.technologies:
Technologies Used:
Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
UI Libraries: Web Speech API, FontAwesome, Swiper.js
AI Backend: DeepSeek V3 / Mistral-7B (OpenRouter)
Backend & Hosting: Node.js, Cloudflare, Netlify
Version Control: GitHub

projects.title: Doodle Board
projects.description: A lightweight, browser-based whiteboard application designed for solo use. It allows users to draw, erase, save, and load sketches directly within their browser, offering a smooth, responsive interface optimized for both mouse and touch input.
projects.technologies:
Technologies Used:
Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Canvas & Graphics: HTML5 Canvas API
State Management: Vanilla JavaScript (custom undo/redo stack)
File Handling: FileReader API, Canvas toDataURL
Touch Support: Touch Events API

projects.title: Collaborative Whiteboard
projects.description: A real-time collaborative whiteboard enabling multiple users to draw simultaneously on a shared canvas. Designed for smooth, low-latency drawing experiences across devices using WebSockets and Firebase Realtime Database for live communication.
projects.technologies:
Technologies Used:
Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
Canvas: HTML5 Canvas 2D Context
Real-Time Sync: Firebase Realtime Database / WebSockets
Multi-User State: Event-driven stroke synchronization
